card.name: Secession in Civil War text
card.fires_on: The final piece of the word secession (Sec-ession, se-cession) in 1860s American Civil War history, especially state conventions and ordinances. Rarely fires on the middle of other rare words like synecdoche.

modes.label: Secession ending
modes.description: The closing piece of a split-up 'secession' in Civil War era text, often in lists of state convention events.

modes.label: Other rare word
modes.description: Weak firing partway through the rare word synecdoche.

card.plain: It lights up on the end of the word secession when it is broken into pieces in Civil War history text.
